panels.focus: Who appears in Australian news : and who produces it.
panels.why: Diversity claims only become meaningful when lived experience and industry practice can test them.
ask: What does meaningful media diversity look like in practice?
What would make platform-publisher arrangements more accountable to diverse audiences?

panels.focus: Local and independent newsrooms sustaining public-interest reporting.
panels.why: Bargaining and incentive design land differently for smaller publishers than for large corporate groups.
ask: How do local and independent outlets experience bargaining power in practice?
What transparency would help smaller publishers assess whether support is reaching them?
